reviews.outcome: The finite-positive-rule operator presentation supports an elementary new entry after effective-operators and turing-degrees. Prove composition, the c.e. bottom degree and the total-information embedding directly using existing finite coding and finite successful oracle traces. Include empty and finite sets via enumeration operators, or explicitly allow pauses in enumerations; do not adopt an onto-N-to-A enumeration convention for the empty set. Selman’s nonuniform-to-uniform characterization, structural enumeration-degree results and computable-structure applications are outside this scope. No defect asserted or whole-book audit claimed.
